description: Validate a phone number and enrich it with carrier, line type (mobile/landline/voip), country, location, timezone, and national/international formatting. Costs 1 phone-validation credit per successful call. Use when you need to know whether a number is real, who operates it, or where it is registered.

country_code.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country hint (for example, "US" or "IN") for a local/national phone_number. This is not a numeric calling prefix such as +91. Omit it, or use the literal "none", only with a full international number.

phone_number.description: Phone number to validate. When country_code is omitted or set to none, provide the full international number including its country calling code, preferably E.164 (for example, +14155552671). A local or national number requires country_code.

name: validate_phone
